concept: Aurora Global Database: cross-Region reads and DR
tests: Choosing a relational DB with 6 copies across 3 AZs, auto-growing storage, and reads from multiple Regions.
expected: Aurora with Global Database — 6 copies across 3 AZs, auto-scaling storage, up to 5 read-only secondary Regions. Triggers: "relational", "six copies across three AZs", "low-latency reads from multiple Regions".
why_not: RDS MySQL Multi-AZ is single-Region and the standby is not readable; DynamoDB Global Tables is NoSQL, not relational; Redshift is analytics, not OLTP.
